next_batch.name: Whole-intent, recipient-aware forward settlement feedback for current direct Human destinations
next_batch.value: A user who selects Alice and Bob should get a final result naming Alice and Bob even when Alice confirms on the first attempt and Bob on retry; three or more recipients should use original total. Today the final retry projects only its one-result subset.
next_batch.dependency_clear_reason: The shipping entry, account-lifetime guard, ordered original recipient IDs, authorized recipient names, strict acknowledgement validation, partial retry subset, source journal and existing notice/roster projection already exist. No new protocol, store, service, native self identity or entitlement is needed for this single-message/direct-recipient presentation slice.
next_batch.existing_owner: ForwardMessageDialog UI intent presentation + forward-settlement.ts notice projection + ProductionRenderer wiring; ProductionSessionWorkers/HumanForwardBatch retain all authorization, dispatch, persistence and remote settlement authority.
minimum_design: Retain ordered recipient display descriptors for selected IDs across filtered search results; freeze a presentation snapshot alongside the existing immutable request at first dispatch. Names are display-only and cannot enter authorization or alter the wire request.

Within that dialog lifetime, keep confirmed IDs only after the existing exact-one-result/per-requested-ID validation accepts sent. Merge confirmations monotonically across failed-only retries; missing, duplicate, unexpected or thrown outcomes never fabricate confirmation.

Pass a presentation context carrying original recipients and cumulative validated confirmation to the existing settlement projection. Emit a partial-progress notice while any original destination remains unconfirmed; emit final single-message one-name/two-name/many-count success only once all original destinations confirm.

Keep roster refresh independent of phrase generation, preserve failure behavior, and retain account checks before notice/read and after async roster response. Dialog close/reopen/source/account changes retire summary state just like existing intent state.

Use safe plain-text rendering and count fallback for unavailable descriptors; never show Forwarded to 0 as successful completion. Preserve privacy, target bound, byte snapshot, retry nonce and preframe cancellation behavior.
next_batch.new_oracle_proposal: ORA-TDRP-FORWARD-RESULT-PROJECTION-001 (draft identifier; parent allocates canonical ID)
falsifiable_cases: One selected Alice: before acknowledgement no success; one validated sent yields Message forwarded to Alice exactly once.
Exactly two recipients selected across different queries: both sent produces Alice and Bob in original order even if current search shows neither.
Three-plus recipients: final count is original unique target count, not current filtered result count or retry subset.
Alice sent/Bob failed then retry Bob sent: first notice remains explicitly partial; retry sends only Bob with original nonce/privacy; final notice names Alice and Bob.
Missing, duplicate, contradictory or unexpected target rows do not promote any affected ambiguous confirmation; thrown retry leaves previous confirmations but no terminal success.
Close/reopen/source replacement/account A-B-A/unmount before delayed result produces no old notice or roster and does not affect a new intent.
Unknown/missing recipient label uses bounded count fallback, and empty original set cannot yield a success notice.
Stale roster response after account rotation cannot repopulate current roster; roster rejection cannot roll back already valid result.
